remarks: Totally renovated 2nd and 3rd floor apartment in the heart of downtown Greenwich with large eat-in kitchen, 3 bedrooms, renovated bath, living room and den/office. Close distance to schools, Metro North Greenwich station, and restaurants and shops on Greenwich Avenue. Heat and hot water, snow removal, and trash removal are all included in the rent Electric and cable are the only tenant responsibilities. Coin-operated laundry room with table for folding clothes. Outdoor space in the bi-level yard is great for BBQs and entertaining. Super clean and ready for move-in now. If you're looking for more storage and closets, this is definitely your next apartment! No smoking.
